subject.title: feat(eval): add GPT-5.6 Luna and Terra models

question: Should GPT-5.6 Luna and Terra become part of ShellBench’s default native evaluation matrix, increasing a full run from 72 to 96 scheduled runs?
rationale: The code change is narrow, but adding models changes the default benchmark scope, provider-call volume, and required availability assumptions; that is a maintainer-owned evaluation-policy choice.

options.title: Approve the expanded default matrix
options.body: Merge after the stacked native-runner work lands and a real native run confirms both provider IDs and the configured reasoning effort.

options.title: Keep variants opt-in
options.body: Retain the catalog entries only behind explicit model selection so existing full-suite runs remain at their current scope and cost.
